text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so pretty...! It's like we're walking 
underwater, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking it would be a nice change of pace 
for Buena Vista, we visited the aquarium 
together. ...And that was when it 
happened.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah... I think your phone is ringing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at my phone, it was an incoming 
call from Tracen Academy. I assumed it was 
about work, but I was with Buena Vista 
right now...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be you're looking out for me? 
...Fufu, I'm fine. Don't worry about it.
choice_data_list: Sorry! Just wait a tiny bit for me!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
“—So, all the necessary documents have 
been submitted, correct? Understood. 
Excuse me.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hang up the phone. That took a little 
too long; I need to get back to Buena 
Vista.
choice_data_list: ...Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A memory suddenly resurfaces. Even when we 
were little, there was a time I had kept 
her waiting—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when she grew tired from 
walking, and we were taking a break 
together on a bench.
choice_data_list: That's it! I'll go buy you a drink.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? W-Wait! I want to go with you, 
Big Brother...!"
choice_data_list: You're tired, right? Just rest, Buena!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? W-Wait! I want to go with you, 
Big Sister...!"
choice_data_list: You're tired, right? Just rest, Buena!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onii-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onee-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it took me quite a while to find 
a vending machine...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*...! Uwaaah...! Big brother... where 
are youuu...?
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! For making you wait...!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*...! Uwaaah...! Big sister... where 
are youuu...?
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! For making you wait...!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! U-Uwaaaah~...!! Big Brother... I'm 
so relieved~...!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! U-Uwaaaah~...!! Big Sister... I'm 
so relieved~...!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Buu-chan was scared... that she might be 
alone forever...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember it even now. The sight of them 
bawling, hating to be left all alone. That 
young voice calling out my name—
choice_data_list: O-Oh, right. Let's play together! Um—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In his memories, she was prone to 
loneliness. He always felt that he had to 
stay by her side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Buena Vista isn't a young child 
anymore. ...However—
choice_data_list: I have to get back quickly...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Sorry! To have kept you waiting—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Your mommy will be here soon. 
So don't be scared, okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: *Hic*...! *Sniff*, ugh...!
choice_data_list: Huh...? Who's that child?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome back...! Um, you see, it looks 
like I got a little lost. I already told 
the staff, though...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"...Mommy, where are you...? Hic... I 
don't wanna be alone...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay. You're not alone. See? Your 
big sister is right here with you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I know! Shall we play together until your 
mommy comes? Do you know this song?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yankee Doodle went to town, riding on a 
pony♪ Stuck a feather in his cap and 
called it macaroni~♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*...! ...Yankee Doodle... went 
to town...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Whenever I play this game, that 
lonely feeling magically disappears.
choice_data_list: （…Wait, could that be—）

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, good job, good job! You did it 
properly, what a good kid.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah…… ……Ehehe……

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Alright, how about we try picking up the 
pace just a little? Don't worry, I know 
you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, Buena Vista played hand games 
with the lost child—"

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! It seems my child was in 
your care... Come on, say hello to the 
nice girl.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm so glad you got to see your 
mother.
choice_data_list: (...That's amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today turned out to be such a 
wonderful day. ...I'm glad she was able to 
smile.
choice_data_list: Could that 'Yankee Doodle' hand game be...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so you remembered. You used to play 
with me a lot whenever I cried, after all.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Alps, ten thousand feet high, upon a 
little goat...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I messed up...! One more time! Let's 
do it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I just thought that maybe that 
game would make her smile too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because I understand what it feels like to 
be all alone and lonely.
choice_data_list: (...She's really grown, hasn't she?)
(...She's really grown, hasn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel a sense of respect. 
She's no longer the lonely, clingy little 
girl she used to be.
choice_data_list: You've become a fine big sister, huh.

You've become a fine big sister, haven't 
you?
I'm so moved I could cry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel a sense of respect. 
She's no longer the lonely, clingy little 
girl she used to be.
choice_data_list: You've become a fine big sister, huh.

You've become a fine big sister, haven't 
you?
I'm so moved I could cry...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you think so? I hope that's how it 
looked to that lost child too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she'll look up to me one day! 
...Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Are you okay? Do you need a 
handkerchief...!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, it feels kind of strange, 
doesn't it? Ever since we were little, I 
was always the one crying.
